## History

John Andrew, also known as [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md), was responsible for painting the village hall during an [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) project. He used a bright blue paint instead of the intended green due to a confusion with the paint numbers, resulting in a hideous appearance for the hall. Despite this mistake, his actions unexpectedly shifted public sympathy in favor of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), leading the local community to rally around them.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_
